title.value: Machine and Deep Learning Methods with Manual and Automatic Labelling for News Classification in Bangla Language
title.justification: The title was chosen because it succinctly encapsulates the primary objective and methods of the paper, focusing on news classification in the Bangla language using deep learning methods.
title.quote: Machine and Deep Learning Methods with Manual and Automatic Labelling for News Classification in Bangla Language

extractions.description: This paper introduces various machine and deep learning methods for news classification in the Bangla language, employing both manual and automatic labelling systems. It explores several machine learning algorithms like Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine, as well as deep learning algorithms such as LSTM and CNN. The study involves developing Potrika, a comprehensive dataset for news classification in Bangla, evaluating manual vs automatic labelling, and addressing the challenges in Automatic Labelling using LDA for single and multi-label classification.
